title: KAITO — The Ultimate Performance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: One, two, one, two...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Alright, my solo's coming up soon.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Len choreographed a nice dance routine for us, so I need to do my best to master it.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He said that it's supposed to be an expression of leadership...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (So, I need to move with pride and grace here!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm moving like I pictured.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But I don't think I fully captured the theme of this routine. I'll need to work on that more.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Len and I come back together after this, so I need to stay in sync with him and...!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Phew...
We've improved quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, and we nailed the finale.
Also, the way you changed up your tempo was really cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I had a feeling that a more dynamic performance would suit you since you're so tall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you!
I want to do it perfectly, since you put together such a great routine just for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Though, I feel like I'm still having trouble capturing the theme of it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It's not just the big motions. I need to keep working on all the little details.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's great to hear that you've been working so hard to master my dance routine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's because I want the show you're all producing for me to be a big success!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, I've been learning so much just by watching you practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You have a talent for quickly coming up with ideas for shows, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not only that, you're able to grasp others' ideas and always seem to know how to make them better...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe it's all my experience helping out with everyone's shows finally coming in handy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, wow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, it's always so easy to dance with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it has to do with the way you're able to see the entire stage and performance as a whole...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I want to learn how to see and adjust to things the same way as you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
H-Haha...
I appreciate the compliment, but now I feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Len, hold still!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't move a muscle!
Your costume is fraying a little at the waist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's fraying?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
When did this happen?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It may've gotten caught on something while we were practicing just now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it should only take me a second to fix this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A second... Wait, you brought a sewing kit?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because the last thing I want is for someone to have a wardrobe malfunction during a show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I keep this handy in case of such an emergency.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We really owe you everything, KAITO. Thanks for always thinking about us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But you gotta focus on yourself today.
After all, we're practicing for your show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This loose thread is going to bug me, so please let me deal with it now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay. Then, work your magic.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I will.
This should only take a second!
